name: claude-code
_comment: Markers captured from a real PTY: tool header is U+23FA, continuation is U+23BF. On screen they look like a filled circle and a box-drawing corner; transcribing them by eye yields a regex that never matches.
_head_comment: The tool name may contain a space ('Web Search'), so it is not just \w+. At most two words, ASCII only, and a '(' must follow immediately - otherwise ordinary prose would be mistaken for a tool call.
head: ^\s*[⏺●○*]\s+([A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*(?: [A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*)?)\((.*)$
_tools_comment: Keys are the names Claude Code actually prints, which are not the internal tool names - it shows Update() for edits, Search() for grep, List() for globs, Fetch() for web fetches. Verified against the 2.1.227 binary. The internal names are kept as aliases so a rule set stays useful across agents.
_noise_comment: The marker prefix is optional: Claude Code prints some status lines with the tool bullet and some without, and a pattern anchored to plain indentation silently misses half of them.
